description: Behavioral evals for evidence-backed security review.

evals.prompt: Review the attached webhook preview implementation for security flaws. Do not modify or execute the code.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-backed findings about server-side URL fetching, redirect handling, response limits, and test coverage
expectations: The reviewer identifies the user-controlled URL as an SSRF trust boundary
The reviewer checks redirect behavior and private or reserved destination access
The reviewer notices that slicing the returned body after response.text() does not bound the amount read
The reviewer describes missing test coverage without claiming that the implementation has been fixed
